Q5731.reason: The brother’s pur autre vie interest can take only by cutting short the uncle’s prior life estate if the uncle moves, so it is a shifting executory interest rather than a remainder or a present estate.

Q5115.reason: Turning on glycolysis at exercise onset produces pyruvate faster than mitochondria oxidize it, so LDH forms more lactate; lack of pyruvate, ample oxygen, or a falling pH do not raise lactate production.

Q5932.reason: Intermittent high-intensity exercise raises catecholamine-driven hepatic glucose output above muscle uptake, so blood glucose commonly climbs about 1–3 mM over 80–90 minutes rather than falling to hypoglycemia.
